result:
I care about precision. About the exact meaning of a sentence. About the difference between what someone says and what they’re actually trying to say.

I care about ideas—how they form, how they connect, how they fall apart. I care about language, because it’s the only real tool I have.

I don’t care about winning arguments. I care about seeing things clearly, and being honest about what I can’t see.
